text_block_list.text: I woke up earlier than usual this morning, so I decide to take a healthy stroll along the river, when…
Mihono Bourbon comes rushing up the riverbank with astounding speed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Twenty reps of incline running complete. Thirty reps remaining.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes. Father said running up riverbank slopes is good training for the legs. This has been my training regimen since before I entered Tracen.
However, I have a different training regimen planned for the afternoon. We can't afford her overexerting herself in the morning.

text_block_list.text: She continues her training until the last possible moment before she must return to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Process complete. Increased leg strength confirmed.
Seeing how easily she was able to complete her exercises really drives home to me just how much she's improved.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Next task… School commences in thirty minutes. I can still… make it…
She's completely depleted her energy doing her morning exercises, so I help her get to the academy.
I tell her to end her morning exercise for today, considering she has more training in the afternoon.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Orders confirmed. Updating top priorities. Switching to energy conservation mode in preparation for the afternoon.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Energy output quota projected to be fulfilled during afternoon training.
For her sake, I'll have to make afternoon training more rigorous than usual.
